name: Leadership
primaryTexts: Gain 3 command tokens
Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent
If you control the Planet Mecatol Rex you gain 2 additional command tokens and choose up to 2 players to gain 1 additional command token
secondaryTexts: Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent

name: Diplomacy
primaryTexts: Choose 1 system other than the Mecatol Rex system that contains a planet you control; each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in the chosen system. Then, ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.
For each legendary planet you control, choose one unique player to place a command token from reinforcements in that system.
secondaryTexts: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to ready up to 2 exhausted planets you control.

name: Politics
primaryTexts: If you control the planet Mecatol Rex draw two relics and shuffle one of those relics back into the relic deck. Then draw 3 actions cards.
If you do not control the planet Mecatol Rex draw one relic and 1 action card.
secondaryTexts: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 2 action cards.

name: Construction
primaryTexts: Either place 1 structure on a planet you control, or use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks.
Place 1 structure on a planet you control.
If you control Mecatol Rex or another player’s home system place one mech and 3 infantry on Mecatol Rex and every planet you control in any home system
secondaryTexts: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 1 structure on a planet you control.

name: Trade
primaryTexts: Gain 3 trade goods
Replenish commodities
If you control Mecatol Rex choose up to 2 players to use the secondary ability of this strategy card without spending a command token
If you do not control Mecatol Rex choose any number of players to use the secondary ability of this strategy card without spending a command token
secondaryTexts: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to replenish your commodities.

name: Warfare
primaryTexts: Perform a tactical action in any system without placing a command token, even if the system already has your command token in it: that system still counts as being activated. You may redistribute your command tokens before and after this action.
If at the end of this action you control Mecatol Rex or another player’s home system Place a dreadnaught, a cruiser and 2 fighters in that system
secondaryTexts: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool. Then, you may either use the PRODUCTION abilities of the units in your home system or spend 4 resources to participate in the unit upgrade splice.

name: Technology
primaryTexts: Research 1 technology.
Spend 6 resources to research 1 technology: for every legendary planet you control you may reduce the cost by 2 resources and ignore 1 prerequisite of any color
secondaryTexts: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and 4 resources to research 1 technology.

name: Imperial
primaryTexts: Immediately score 1 public objective if you fulfill its requirements
Gain 1 relic if you control Mecatol Rex; otherwise draw 1 secret objective
secondaryTexts: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 1 secret objective
